tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Palette swatch, same in both themes. Light background. Use through `surface`; directly only in the hero split.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Palette swatch. Borders and dividers in light; muted text on Char. Also the portrait backdrop.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Palette swatch. Muted text on Paper (6.97:1). Fails AA on Char: never use it on dark grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Palette swatch. Headings and body on Paper (14.47:1).

tokens.name: char
tokens.usage: Palette swatch. Dark background; the right half of the hero split.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Palette swatch, the only brand colour. Accent on light grounds (5.05:1 on Paper). Use through `accent`.

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: Palette swatch. Hover and pressed accent on light grounds (6.12:1 on Paper).

tokens.name: ember-glow
tokens.usage: Palette swatch. Accent on dark grounds (6.65:1 on Char).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the default band.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate band background, to separate neighbouring sections.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Code block background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers between bands and around cards. Decorative only: under 3:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered card borders and the kbd outline. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-alt` in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `surface-code` (13.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, notes, nav, the word strip. On every surface, at least 6.5:1 light and 11.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata, dates, code comments. At least 5.0:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember. Wordmark hyphens, text links, the underline on "Careful", focus rings, code keywords. Nothing else. At least 4.7:1 on every surface in both themes. Never apply opacity to it.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered and pressed links. At least 5.7:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill, if one is ever needed (5.05:1 light, 6.65:1 dark). The site currently has no Ember fills.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Status: maintained. Badge text and border only, always with its word. At least 7.1:1 on the surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: Status: experimental. Badge text and border only, always with its word. At least 7.1:1 on the surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: claret
tokens.usage: Status: archived. Badge text and border only, always with its word. At least 5.4:1 on the surfaces in both themes.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: The wordmark is type. Hyphens take `accent`.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: General Sans. Give headings text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and page titles (h1 on inner pages, h2 in bands). Fluid: clamp(1.6rem, 3.4vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles and h3 in articles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy is set at 17px with a 1.55 line height.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: One line on what the project does and who it is for.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, reading time, the footer hint.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, for code and data only.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges and tech tags. Lowercase, no letter-spacing.

spacing.note: 4px base. Band padding is fluid between space-8 and space-9.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot-to-word gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges and tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its paragraph.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs and links in a row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the heading column and content on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between the heading column and content on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Band padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Band padding on desktop.

radius.note: Nearly square. Corners are a hint, never a shape.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, badges, tags, code blocks, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The portrait and the mark tile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular avatar crops only.

layout.note: One content column with a gutter that grows with the viewport.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content wrapper.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the content wrapper.

tokens.name: heading-column
tokens.usage: Width of a band's left heading column on desktop.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.

tokens.name: band-padding
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a band.
